truth_rule: The committed bytes the portal's tests consume at portal_base are the truth. The generator was repaired to reproduce them; no output file was edited by hand. Byte-equality of each of the six outputs with the committed bytes was measured after the repaired generator ran.

outputs.what_the_generator_changed: Wire keys are mapped to the committed bare route prefixes (committedKey: performance/, analysis/, narrative/, status/, export/, holdings/); the holdings key is resolved from the wire map's own keys by prefix (wireKeyFor). The export envelope drops facts.covered_account_ids (exportEnvelope). directory/resolve verified_request_firm_id is set to the report's own lineage.tenant_firm_id, F-49F, which paired.test.ts names as the frozen report's tenant (resolveAnswering). unprojected_grant is appended last to the performance and narrative envelopes from the wire's envelope of the same family (withWireGrant). The status carries no internal_correlation_id, as committed. Every input is read before the first write.

Built from the frozen map's keys (the same committed-shape mapping) with the holdings envelope taken from the wire by resolved key (wireKeyFor); nodes and custody totals as before; status from FE_S_26_STATUS without internal_correlation_id. directory/resolve verified_request_firm_id is set to the envelope's own firm_id, fir_4f9c1a7b2e6d03518ca47b90 (resolveAnswering), instead of the frozen map's F-49F, which the base generator copied. Line endings kept per file.

Same construction as the observed map with the target basis and target status (FE_S_26_STATUS target, without internal_correlation_id). directory/resolve verified_request_firm_id is the envelope firm_id fir_4f9c1a7b2e6d03518ca47b90, not the frozen F-49F. Line endings kept per file.

Same construction with the nodes carrying no classification object (withClassification false) and the missing-attribution status from FE_S_26_STATUS without internal_correlation_id. directory/resolve verified_request_firm_id is the envelope firm_id fir_4f9c1a7b2e6d03518ca47b90, not the frozen F-49F. Line endings kept per file.

Built from the observed map as before, with the holdings status replaced by FE_S_32_NO_ANSWER_STATUS without internal_correlation_id; every other member, including directory/resolve (fir_4f9c1a7b2e6d03518ca47b90), is the observed map's. Line endings kept per file.

No content change needed: performance comes from fe-s-16-print-narrative.json and narrative from the pre-history wire, which is now read with the other inputs before the first write. The base run threw at the holdings read before reaching this write, so it had never reproduced this file; the repaired generator reproduces it byte for byte. Named consumer: no test reads this file by name at HEAD; the generic smoke classifier parses every smoke file (surprise row IRPT_BCKEND-D2-W353-S4).
